# FTIGenerateMagnon

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FTI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FTI/FTIGenerateMagnon`

```text
FTIGenerateMagnon, version 0.01

Usage: FTIGenerateMagnon [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --eigenstate-file : name of the vector file to which the magnon operator should be applied
    --degenerate-groundstate : name of the file that gives the vector files to which the  magnon operator should be applied (in all-bilinear or sma mode)
    --only-kx : only evalute a given x momentum sector (negative if all kx sectors have to be computed) (default value = -1)
    --only-ky : only evalute a given y momentum sector (negative if all ky sectors have to be computed) (default value = -1)
    --creation-only : only apply the creation operators to the states
    --annihilation-only : only apply the creation operators to the states

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:

tools options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
